g.text: Top quintile on heat exposure alone,
Rank on heat exposure alone (1 = most exposed)
Rank on risk to residents aged 65+ (1 = highest)
Rank by heat exposure alone (what indicator 9_3 measures) vs rank by risk to older residents. Spearman rho = 0.775, 30 countries, 2020.
Exposure is not risk: the same countries, ranked two ways
Risk = equal-weight rank score of heat-stress days, summer night urban heat island, share aged 65+, green space per person (inverse).
Source: OECD CFE functional urban area dataflows via the SDMX API. Cities over 100,000 residents with all layers present.
